_comment: Where Odyssey's alerts go, outside this laptop: the apps your team already uses. Every string may use ${ENV_VAR} or ${ENV_VAR:default}. Put real webhook URLs and SMTP credentials in config/notify.local.json (git-ignored; same shape, merged over this file by channel name) or in the environment, never here. A channel whose url (or SMTP host and recipient) is empty is shown as 'not configured' and is never sent to. The analysis stays on this laptop; only the alerts you route leave it, to the destinations you name.

routing._comment: Which audit-trail events become alerts. kinds are glob patterns on the ledger kind; min_severity drops anything below it; dedupe_minutes sends one alert per (kind, subject) in that window; per_minute_cap bounds the flood into a real channel, with one summary line for what was held back. The story is told once: the detection, the CVE taken in, the re-score, the case, the escalation and the decision waiting. Per-organisation notices (auto.notify: one per operator, eleven for one CVE) and the hunt/report mechanics are deliberately not routed; add them here if a channel should carry every notice.
